full_prompt_en: A square monochrome cinematic image looks straight down a bright, symmetrical futuristic corridor through a circular doorway. The dark outer frame forms a broad ring around the scene, with the round opening centered precisely in the composition. Inside it, the corridor extends toward a small rectangular far wall and a single central vanishing point. Repeating white ribs arch over the ceiling and continue along both side walls, their dark joints creating a measured sequence of nested rectangles. Narrow panels and ceiling lights lead the eye down the long axis. On the left and right, low built-in seats line the passage. Several people sit or recline along them, their subdued gray clothing and relaxed postures much smaller than the enclosing geometry. A figure stands near the middle distance, almost aligned with the center line. The pale floor stretches uninterrupted toward that figure, carrying faint shadows and reflections from the seats and structural ribs. Light is cool, even, and overhead, washing the white surfaces while leaving the circular doorway and some corners charcoal gray. The strong contrast between bright interior and dark round foreground gives the scene depth without loose atmospheric haze. Details remain crisp enough to read the repeated panels, but faces are too small to specify. The viewpoint is perfectly frontal and level, so both sides mirror one another even as the seated figures introduce small irregularities. The overall composition feels controlled and uncanny, balancing precise white perspective with quiet human activity inside the long passage.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形单色电影画面从一道圆形门洞正面望向明亮、对称的未来走廊。深色外框在场景周围形成宽圆环，圆形开口精确地居中。其内，走廊延伸向一面小矩形尽头墙和一个中央消失点。重复的白色肋架跨过天花，并沿两侧墙面延续，深色接缝形成节制的嵌套矩形序列。窄板块与顶灯引导视线沿长轴前进。左右两边的低矮内置座位沿通道排开。几个人坐着或斜倚其上，低调灰色衣服和放松姿态相对围合几何显得很小。一道身影立在中景附近，几乎与中线重合。浅色地面不被打断地延伸向那个人，带座椅和结构肋架投下的微影与反光。光冷而均匀，从上方洗亮白色表面，圆形前景门洞和部分角落保持炭灰色。明亮内部与深色圆形前景的强对照使场景有纵深，而无需松散空气雾。细节足够清楚，可辨重复板块，面孔却太小，无法细述。视点完全正面而平视，所以两侧互相映照，坐着的人又引入细小不规则。整体构图受控而奇异，以精确白色透视平衡长通道里的安静人间活动。
style_prompt_en: The cinematic image organizes space through exact central symmetry, repeated hard-edged modules, and a strong one-point perspective. Cool white and pale gray dominate an illuminated interior field, while a broad charcoal foreground border acts as a rigid frame. Even overhead light reveals every plane with clinical clarity; small contact shadows and restrained reflections prevent the space from becoming flat. Human-scale dark accents appear sparingly within much larger geometric repetition. The composition is quiet, controlled, and subtly unsettling because its balance is so exact.
style_prompt_zh: 这种电影图像通过精确中央对称、重复硬边模块和强烈单点透视组织空间。冷白与浅灰主导受照亮的内部色域，宽阔炭灰前景边框成为坚硬框架。均匀顶光以近乎临床的清晰揭示每个平面；小接触影和克制反光防止空间变平。人尺度暗色重音稀疏地出现在更大的几何重复中。构图安静、受控，又因平衡过于精确而略有不安。
theme_en: A symmetrical bright corridor seen through a dark circular doorway
theme_zh: 从深色圆门洞望向一条对称明亮的走廊
name: Stanley Kubrick
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
